independent_exact_oracle.method: forward BFS over the exact sequence-state graph; each legal equal cyclic triplet and all replacement values enumerated

E.x1_reason: Frozen N!/m! anchor hypothesis is globally falsified by arrangement-sensitive exact reachability. Repair requires a qualitatively new reachability theorem/construction, not a bounded local correction.

independent_exact_oracle.exhaustive_domain: N=1..3, all ordered endpoint pairs with A_i,B_i in {1,2,3}

D.proof_gate: For l_i=min(A_i,B_i), r_i=max(A_i,B_i), [L,R] is feasible iff L<=min r, R>=max l, and R>=max_{l_i<L} r_i. The optimum occurs at L=min r or an inserted l_i. Frozen monotone envelope data structure maintains this expression exactly.

independent_exact_oracle.exhaustive_domain: all partial injective Q for N=2..5, compared with enumeration of every initial permutation and exact one-pass bubble simulation

C.proof_gate: Full output R must end in N. Every preimage corresponds bijectively to a subset of left-to-right record positions of R including N, hence multiplicity 2^(records(R)-1). Processing values descending, a value is a record iff its assigned position is smaller than the minimum position of all larger values; reserved fixed positions make that minimum sufficient state. Frozen DP exactly sums these weighted assignments.
